mechanism: Systemic absorption of timolol from ophthalmic formulation can potentiate the hypotensive and bradycardic effects of bumetanide, while bumetanide-induced hypokalemia may increase risk of arrhythmias with concurrent beta-blockade.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum potassium regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions.
